Simulated reading saved on this phone.
Saves every 5 seconds while running. The latest 20 simulated readings stay separate from real vehicle history.

1. Power: the OBD-II port supplies the reader from the vehicle electrical system. Bluetooth does not power it.

2. Pair: the phone connects to a compatible Bluetooth reader.

3. Read: CarMind asks for supported RPM, speed and coolant temperature. The reader relays the request to the vehicle and returns the response.

4. Display: our software turns the response into readable values and saves dated snapshots. It does not control the vehicle.

This walkthrough uses generated data and never opens Bluetooth. With a real car, use the real dashboard; it reads one snapshot per request. Reader compatibility must still be tested.
